description: Unicorn cake pops with pastel flowers, closed eyes and horns.
Pink crowned Lambeth cake; needs visual tier check.

A set of pastel pink cakesicles on wooden sticks showcases delicate gold butterfly and bowknot decorations, accented by tiny white sprinkles. The smooth, glossy coating and refined embellishments create an elegant dessert presentation perfect for upscale gatherings.

A collection of sugar cookies iced in pastel pink and white presents a cohesive bow-themed design perfect for celebrating a baby girl. The assortment includes bow-shaped cookies with smooth icing, heart-shaped treats speckled with gold accents, and baby romper shapes adorned with gingham patterns and tiny pockets. Bunny silhouettes and floral details add a whimsical touch to the elegant display.

A pastel pink and white two-tiered cake celebrates an eighth birthday with a Roblox theme. The top tier is adorned with marshmallows, chocolate squares, and pink candy swirls, while three Roblox character toppers stand beside a bold sign proclaiming “FREYA IS 8.” The front of the cake features the iconic Roblox logo in matching pink and white tones, tying the design together for a playful and festive party centerpiece.
